[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## 🏗️ How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The suite follows DSH's own three-role package pattern (`packages/fs/{fs, fs-local, tool-fs}`): **Se"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"rvice Definition → Provider → Consumer**."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Key design decisions:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **One seam, many hosts.** A Cordis service name registers once, so `gitPlatform` is a *registry*: "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"adapters register via `registerProvider` (same pattern as `ctx.llm.registerAdapter`), and the regist"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ry detects the host from the repo's origin remote URL.
- **Typed, grouped tools.** Seven workflow gr"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"oups instead of dozens of flat verbs; each action has typed parameters and validates before dispatch"},{"id":"p30s5","text":".
- **Hardening in the tool layer.** Approval gates, sandbox policy stamping, and escalation fields "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"live in `tool-git`, not in the providers."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## 🔒 Security"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Secrets are env-var **references**, resolved per operation, never cached, never logged.
- Destruct"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ive git operations require explicit approval when the host approval service is present.
- Mutations "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"run under the resolved `sandboxPolicy`; `sandbox_permissions` escalation mirrors the harness's own f"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"ile tools.
- Memory is scrubbed before persistence; the harness's credential and sandbox layers are "},{"id":"p32s5","text":"never bypassed.
- Commands shell out to the real `git` binary with `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` so missin"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"g credentials fail fast instead of hanging."}],"truncated":true}
